k, p = map(int, input().split())

M = 10**9 + 7

if k == 0:
    cnt = p - 1
elif k == 1:
    cnt = p
else:
    cnt = 0
    vis = [False] * p
    for i in range(1, p):
        if not vis[i]:
            vis[i] = True
            cnt += 1
            j = (i * k) % p
            while not vis[j]:
                vis[j] = True
                j = (j * k) % p

ans = 1
for _ in range(cnt):
    ans = (ans * p) % M

print(ans)
